<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">◤──•~Welcome to Ascendra 10x~•──◥</>

<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">We're a laid-back, feature-packed PvE Ark Ascended server built for players who just want to enjoy the game.</>

<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">Don’t forget to check the Info/Commands tab and read through the Server Rules.</>

content.title: <RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">◤──•~Extra Info!~•──◥</>
content.text:
<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">◤──•~Weekend Boosted Rates!~•──◥</>

<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">On weekends, we have some boosted rates for players to enjoy!</>

<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">These last from 11pm Friday – 11pm Sunday (PST)</>

<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">What are the boosts?</>
<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">XP x2</>
<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">Player Harvest x2</>
<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">Dino Harvest x2</>
<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">Taming x1.3</>

<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">These are x2 our normal rates, eg server xp rate is 2x, making the weekend 4x</>

<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">◤──•~Additional Settings and Info!~•──◥</>

<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">Offline Player Protection – PLAYERS AND DINOS CANNOT BE DAMAGED OFFLINE</>

<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">Tribes cannot mate with other tribes dinos unless allied</>

<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">Players cannot turn on/off other tribes structures (unless unlocked)</>

<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">Players cannot open the inventory of other tribes structures unless unlocked/pin coded</>

<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">Oil pumps and tree sap taps are auto unlocked</>

<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">Cannot drag offline players bodies unless allied</>

<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">Flyers cannot pickup non allies players</>

<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">Cannot pickup fertilized eggs belonging to another tribe</>

<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">Cannot pickup items belonging to another tribe unless allied</>

<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">Dropped wyvern eggs despawn after 60s if not incubating at an aircon or campfire</>

<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">– These are in place to prevent griefing and stealing</>

content.title: <RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">◤──•~General Rules!~•──◥</>
content.text:
<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">◤──•~SERVER CHAT & GAMEPLAY~•──◥</>
<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">Discord rules also apply to all in-game chat.</>
<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">Please conduct yourself appropriately and keep conversations respectful.</>

<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">◤──•~DON'T BE A DICK~•──◥</>
<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">Use common sense and show courtesy to other players.</>
<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">Treat others how you would expect to be treated.</>
<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">Keep conversations friendly and constructive.</>
<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">Players who deliberately disrupt the community may be removed.</>

<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">◤──•~CONSIDER OTHERS WHEN BUILDING~•──◥</>
<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">Think carefully before building near another player's base.</>
<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">Multiple large bases close together can negatively affect local FPS and server performance.</>
<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">Building directly on another player's doorstep can interfere with their gameplay.</>
<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">If staff determine that your base is too close to another player, you may be required to move it.</>

<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">◤──•~DON'T TAME CAVE DINOSAURS~•──◥</>
<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">Some cave dinosaurs on DLC maps are not correctly marked as cave creatures.</>
<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">Dinosaurs above the standard wild level range of 150-190 must not be tamed.</>
<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">Achatina and Dung Beetles are excluded from this rule.</>

<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">◤──•~DON'T BLOCK IMPORTANT LOCATIONS~•──◥</>
<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">Do not block access to major resources or important points of interest.</>
<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">This includes:</>
<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">-Artifacts</>
<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">-Explorer Notes</>
<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">-Runes</>
<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">-Charge Nodes</>
<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">-City Terminals</>
<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">-Orbital Supply Drops</>
<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">-Teleporters</>
<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">-Mission Terminals</>
<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">-Major resource locations</>
<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">-Other important points of interest</>
<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">Blocking these locations negatively affects other players' gameplay.</>

content.title: <RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">◤──•~General Rules 2!~•──◥</>
content.text:
<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">◤──•~RAGNAROK RESTRICTION~•──◥</>
<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">Building anywhere inside the Ragnarok Karkinos Cave is prohibited.</>
<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">This cave is one of the only reliable locations on the map for taming Karkinos.</>

<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">◤──•~VALGUERO RESTRICTION~•──◥</>
<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">Building anywhere inside the Valguero Crystal and Metal Cave is prohibited.</>
<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">This cave is one of the most productive resource locations on the map.</>

<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">◤──•~KEEP PLAYER SPAWNS CLEAR~•──◥</>
<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">Avoid building on or around player spawn locations.</>
<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">If your base accidentally overlaps a spawn area, players must have a clear and easy way to leave.</>
<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">Do not trap newly spawned players inside your base.</>

<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">◤──•~REMOVE TRAPS & TEMPORARY STRUCTURES~•──◥</>
<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">Remove traps and temporary structures when you have finished using them.</>
<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">Do not leave unused structures around the map.</>
<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">Abandoned structures may interfere with other players and create unnecessary server load.</>

<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">◤──•~DIGITIZE EXTINCTION TITANS~•──◥</>
<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">Titans on Extinction must be digitized after use.</>
<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">Leaving a Titan active can prevent other players from summoning the associated boss.</>

<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">◤──•~DON'T POPCORN ITEMS~•──◥</>
<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">Do not dump hundreds of unwanted items onto the ground.</>
<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">Large amounts of dropped items can negatively affect server performance.</>
<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">Dispose of unwanted items properly.</>
